title: GitChameleon 2.0: Evaluating AI Code Generation Against Python Library Version Incompatibilities
authors_zh: Diganta Misra, Nizar Islah, Victor May, Brice Rauby, Zihan Wang, Justine Gehring, Antonio Orvieto, Muawiz Sajjad Chaudhary, Eilif B. Muller, Irina Rish, Samira Ebrahimi Kahou, Massimo Caccia
paper_type_zh: 可程序化验证的推理数据或基准
best_for_zh: 需要可复现结果验证的推理数据研究者。
one_line: One-sentence position:** A 328-task benchmark with pinned Python-library versions and unit tests for version-compatible generation.
328 个带固定 Python 库版本和单测的补全任务，专门测版本兼容生成。
why: It exposes a reproducible terminal outcome check rather than only a textual reference.
inclusion_reason: The released resource exposes a reusable programmatic outcome-verification surface.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Code models can often produce code for the latest API but fail to switch implementations when a user specifies an older or newer dependency version. Existing code-evolution benchmarks mainly study migration patches or rely on textual matching, without executing candidate code in the exact requested environment. They therefore cannot establish true compatibility.

GitChameleon 2.0 places version constraints directly in code-completion tasks and supplies pinned dependencies and executable tests. It evaluates LLMs, agents, coding assistants, and RAG systems by whether generated code actually runs under the target library version.

代码模型常能写出“当前最新版”API，却无法根据用户指定的旧版或新版依赖切换实现。已有代码演化基准多关注迁移补丁，或只做文本匹配，没有在精确版本环境中执行候选代码，因此无法判断回答是否真正兼容目标库。

GitChameleon 2.0 将版本条件写进代码补全任务，并为每题提供固定依赖与可执行测试，用执行结果测量 LLM、agent、代码助手和 RAG 系统的版本感知能力。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The current benchmark contains 328 Python completion tasks covering 26 widely used libraries. Each item binds an explicit library version, code context, completion location, and unit tests. The official Hugging Face data and evaluation harness are released separately; submissions use example_id and answer, and evaluation runs in pinned environments. The data object is a versioned problem–candidate code–execution result record, primarily for evaluation and error analysis rather than large-scale training.
当前 benchmark 包含 328 个 Python 补全任务，覆盖 26 个常用库；每个样本绑定明确的库版本、上下文、待补全位置和单元测试。官方 Hugging Face 数据与评测 harness 分离发布，提交文件使用 example_id 与 answer，评测在固定环境中运行。其数据对象是“版本化问题—候选代码—执行结果”，主要用于评测和错误分析，而不是现成的大规模训练语料。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Select version differences: The authors identify Python libraries whose releases change APIs, parameters, or behavior and turn those changes into independently executable completion scenarios.
  1. Construct prompts and tests: Each task provides a target version and local code context. Expected behavior and unit tests are written or reviewed so scoring does not depend on string matching.
  1. Pin execution environments: The harness installs the requested dependency version and runs candidate completions in isolation. A task succeeds only when all tests pass in that exact environment.
  1. Compare tool-augmented systems: Base models, agents, IDE/CLI assistants, and RAG systems are evaluated on the same tasks, with errors analyzed by library and version-change type.

1. 筛选版本差异： 作者选择在不同发行版间存在 API、参数或行为变化的 Python 库，并把变化整理为可独立执行的补全场景。
  1. 构造问题与测试： 每题给出目标版本和局部代码上下文，人工编写或复核期望行为及单元测试，避免仅靠字符串匹配判分。
  1. 固定执行环境： 评测 harness 为目标版本安装依赖并隔离运行候选补全；只有在该版本下通过全部测试才计为成功。
  1. 比较工具增强系统： 在相同任务上测试裸模型、agent、IDE/CLI 助手与 RAG，记录总体成功率和按库、版本变化类型划分的失败。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The paper executes several system classes on the same 328 tasks. Even the strongest enterprise models achieve only about 48–51% baseline success, showing that general coding strength does not automatically yield version-switching ability. The project releases data, pinned environments, and per-task logs for reproducibility. This supports benchmark discriminativeness, but the tests cannot cover every compatibility behavior of each library release.
论文在 328 个任务上统一执行多类系统，最强企业模型的基线成功率仍只有约 48%–51%，说明一般代码能力不能自动转化为版本切换能力。项目页还公开数据、固定环境和逐题日志，可复跑失败。该证据支持 benchmark 具有区分度，但不能证明测试覆盖了每个库版本的全部兼容行为。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Prior work usually asks whether old code can be migrated to a new API. GitChameleon 2.0 instead asks whether a system can directly generate code for a specified version and makes compatibility an execution contract. The novelty is the version-conditioned task design and shared harness across tool settings, not a new code model or testing framework.
以往工作通常问“能否把旧代码迁移到新 API”，GitChameleon 2.0 改问“能否按提示直接生成适配指定版本的代码”，并将版本兼容性落实为执行契约。新意是版本条件化任务设计与跨工具统一 harness，而不是新的代码模型或测试框架。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Scale and language: The 328 tasks cover only Python and 26 libraries and do not represent repository-scale dependency resolution, compiled languages, or complex migrations. New ecosystems need additional tasks.
  1. Test sufficiency: Passing the provided tests establishes only the current oracle. Uncovered behavior may remain wrong, so critical APIs need coverage reporting and independent tests.
  1. Temporal drift: Library releases, images, and package indexes change. Dataset version, containers, Python, and lock files must be frozen for comparable results.

1. 规模与语言： 328 题只覆盖 Python 和 26 个库，不能代表仓库级依赖解析、编译语言或复杂迁移。复用时应按目标生态补充任务。
  1. 测试充分性： 通过测试只说明满足当前 oracle，未覆盖行为仍可能错误；应报告测试覆盖率并对关键 API 增加独立测试。
  1. 时间漂移： 库发布、依赖镜像和安装源会变化。评测必须冻结数据版本、容器、Python 与依赖锁文件，否则结果不可比。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Version-aware evaluation: Use the official harness to compare execution accuracy across model versions and diagnose regressions by library and change type.
  1. RAG and agent ablations: Hold the base model fixed while adding documentation retrieval, version metadata, and execution feedback to separate retrieval gains from repair gains.
  1. Training-set extension: Tasks can seed failed-code–test-feedback–repair trajectories, but licences and leakage must be audited; benchmark test items should not be mixed directly into training.

1. 版本感知评测： 用官方 harness 比较模型升级前后对旧版与新版 API 的执行正确率，并按库和变更类型定位退化。
  1. RAG/agent 消融： 固定 base model，分别加入文档检索、版本标签和工具反馈，判断收益来自检索信息还是执行修复。
  1. 训练集扩展： 可把任务转成失败代码—测试反馈—修复代码轨迹，但需重新检查许可和数据泄漏，不能把 benchmark test 直接混入训练。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. One-sentence position: A 328-task benchmark with pinned Python-library versions and unit tests for version-compatible generation.
  1. Method hook: The target version is placed in the prompt and code is executed under that dependency, rather than compared as text.
  1. Data hook: It covers 26 libraries; data and harness are separate, and submissions contain example_id and answer.
  1. Evidence anchor: The strongest enterprise models reach only about 48–51% baseline success.
  1. Reuse decision: Use it for API migration and version-aware evaluation after freezing images and auditing test coverage.

1. 一句话定位： 328 个带固定 Python 库版本和单测的补全任务，专门测版本兼容生成。
  1. 方法抓手： 关键是把目标版本写入提示，并在对应依赖环境中真实执行，而非比较文本。
  1. 数据抓手： 覆盖 26 个库；官方数据与 harness 分开，提交字段为 example_id 和 answer。
  1. 证据锚点： 最强企业模型基线仅约 48%–51%，说明该任务仍具明显难度。
  1. 复用决定： 适合 API 迁移与版本感知评测；复用前先冻结镜像并审计测试覆盖。
